gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-hanken-grotesk: Marker-bold and gap-mouthed, Shantell Sans keeps a single nib width throughout. Hanken Grotesk saves its best for the wire-bent look across each word, with wide channels leading into every counter.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-host-grotesk: Shantell Sans draws every letter with one fixed nib and a mouth like a cut tin lid. Host Grotesk sweeps its curves open instead of curling them shut, while the heading never swells like a brush.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: IBM Plex Sans JP reads approachable, every curve ending in an open gap. Shantell Sans is the bent-paperclip loud one with no swelling, so text underneath would drift along without any fuss.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-th: Shantell Sans keeps one fixed nib width, with no vertical emphasis and no horizontal thinning. IBM Plex Sans Thai is a plain sans whose c ends point apart like open pincers, so paragraphs would flow smoothly.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-imprima: Shantell Sans hits with a wide tin-lid mouth and a single nib width, every letter drawn with that same nib. Imprima flows smooth as a tube, its flared terminals easing the eye along.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-inclusive-sans: Inclusive Sans reads round and open, every curve ending without a closing stroke. Shantell Sans handles loud, nib-drawn display lines, while this sans keeps its rims matching the stems for steady text.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-jura: Gap-mouthed and nib-steady, Shantell Sans is all personality up top. Jura, a plain sans with constant strokes and s curves open at both ends, would read cleanly paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-kosugi: Expressive from the first letter, Shantell Sans is a fixed-nib display face with a mouth like a cut tin lid. Kosugi handles the clean work, a sans-serif with an open-jawed c.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-lato: Hollow glass-tube lettering with a constant thickness and a wide tin-lid mouth. Lato, a plain sans with wide, barely curled s curves, lets Shantell Sans earn its keep big and short.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-lunasima: Bent-copper-pipe strokes and a mouth like a cut tin lid mark Shantell Sans out. Lunasima, a sans-serif with c tips that never creep toward touching, keeps things clear underneath that loud top line.
